credits_text: A man crosses the precipice from sanity to insanity killing his roommate, then the roommate's long lost daughter and mother and another man. A detective is saved by the zombie bodies. Writer and Director: Dave Sweeney Cast: Nicholas M. Garofolo, John Calvanico, Ashish Patel, Allegra Ashton, Jolie Curran. Cinematography by Marc Frato
moderation_notes: Contains implied violence and gore, suitable for mature audiences.
